claims.evidence: Seller asserts personal testing, but there is no video, diagnostic report, or new photo evidence to verify the test result or “never opened.”

risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant/part number for the specific Mercedes application (compatibility depends on exact gearbox code).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission identification plate/label showing part number + gearbox code (and/or stamped code on the casing), plus donor VIN/model details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown/possibly incompatible variant until the exact code is confirmed.

risks.risk: “Working/no knock” not verifiable remotely; internal wear or intermittent faults may not show in photos.
risks.proof: Video of the transmission test (engage P/R and show no abnormal noise) and/or a diagnostic scan report with fault codes cleared and live data.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may need overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; reseals/repairs can be done without obvious photo proof.
risks.proof: Photos of all gasket/seal lines and any access points (pan/valve body areas) showing no fresh sealant/tool marks; also close-ups of fasteners for tampering.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly opened/repaired (unknown internal history).

risks.risk: Leak/contamination risk (dark staining/grime could indicate leaks or old fluid).
risks.proof: Close-up photos after cleaning plus fluid condition details (color/smell) and whether it was drained for testing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak/contamination risk (worst-case: reseal/flush needed).

risks.risk: Torque converter condition unknown; converter damage can exist even if casing looks intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of converter mounting surfaces/scoring and converter part number; plus test behavior (stall/lock-up) or converter replacement history.
risks.if_unproven: Price as converter condition unknown (worst-case: converter may need replacement).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the transmission identification label/plate showing the exact part number/gearbox code (the photo 0 label area needs to be readable).
Send a short video of the test: demonstrate engagement (P/R) and show no abnormal noise.
Send a diagnostic scan screenshot/report (fault codes + live data) if testing was done with a scanner.
Send photos of gasket/seal lines and any access-pan/valve-body areas to support “never opened.”
response.reason: The seller’s reply is a verbal insistence, but without new photos or test/diagnostic evidence, the key unknowns (exact gearbox code/compatibility and proof of working/never opened) remain unverified from the images. Therefore a reliable worst-case price still can’t be set.
